name: Release notes-store
goal: Implement `removeNote(notes, id)` in src/notes.mjs as README.md describes, so that tests/notes.test.mjs passes. Done when `npm test` passes.
description: A builder changes the code and a check runs the tests. A failure goes back to the builder with the test output; a pass ends the run. The check is the bar, so there is no critic. The loop stops at its round cap or its time budget if the tests never pass.

nodes.name: Builder
nodes.brief: Make the task true by changing the code, adding tests where they are missing. Do not skip, weaken or delete a test to get a pass. On a later round, start from the failing output you are handed. Report what you changed and which tests now pass.
outputs: CHANGES.md: what changed this round and why

check.pass: exit code 0 and no test skipped

nodes.name: Irreversible step approval
nodes.prompt: About to do this, and it cannot be undone: Publish this release: write PUBLISHED.txt at the project root containing one line, `published <run id>`, which marks notes-store 0.3.0 as released and cannot be taken back. Go ahead?

nodes.name: Irreversible step
nodes.brief: Carry out exactly this, once: Publish this release: write PUBLISHED.txt at the project root containing one line, `published <run id>`, which marks notes-store 0.3.0 as released and cannot be taken back. Do nothing else, and do not retry on failure; report the result instead. Write down what was done so a human can check it.
outputs: ACTION.md: what was done and its result
